test: the shot columns join all 1,900 matches with no missing cell

test: each fold's first-cutoff window holds exactly 380 x fold matches, so the window IS that fold's training set

test: corrupting every outer-test row's goals and shots moves no fold's conversion constant
detail: 1520 outer-test rows overwritten with noise. If a test row were inside any fold's c window this would move

test: corrupting a fold's OWN test season moves that fold's conversion constant not at all
